Fact wording unchanged.

facts.speaker: hunter_root
facts.short: Inspired by other's talents, Emotions, Thoughts, Existence, Pain.

facts.speaker: hunter_root
facts.short: We're musically Influenced by: Led Zeppelin, Nirvana, The Doors

facts.speaker: hunter_root
facts.short: Favorite midnight snack: "Cereal."
facts.long: Alex: cold pizza. Wynton: frozen food. Tyler: a Nutella-banana sandwich.
facts.xnote: Composite kept as ONE fact (Ops call recorded at gate).

facts.speaker: alex_aument
facts.short: Wynton's Dad's living room was the first time we played together as a 4-piece band.

facts.speaker: tyler
facts.short: First song the band ever played together: "Strange Chemistry"

facts.speaker: tyler
facts.short: We chose "Questioned By A Ghost" because our super fan Nathan Reinsmith misheard a lyric on our hidden track "Medicine"
facts.xnote: QBAG not a registered album slug — no album tag, per candidates doc.

facts.speaker: hunter_root
facts.short: Park Bench Pigeons — It's growth from my solo album version to the SEEDS creation
facts.long: Hunter, Wynton and Tyler all had solo albums before SEEDS.

facts.speaker: wynton_huddle
facts.short: Queens of the Stone Age, Butthole Surfers, Nirvana, Primus, Syd Barrett-era Pink Floyd, Incubus, Miles Davis, I could go on, surely.

facts.speaker: hunter_root
facts.short: An album that we can listen to on repeat and find a new element to love… Queens Of The Stone Age – Like Clockwork and Incubus – A Crow Left Of The Murder

facts.speaker: harrison_giza
facts.short: Hunter's vocals channel a pre-needle Cobain with Morrison appreciation.

facts.speaker: harrison_giza
facts.short: The solos are just the right amount of melting face you need in your morning coffee.

facts.speaker: blue_harvest_beat
facts.short: In August 2014 the band had been together about a year and a half.
facts.long: Conceived in Lancaster County — Hunter's words to Blue Harvest Beat.

facts.speaker: hunter_root
facts.short: Wynton came up with the main riff in our friend's garage… The band was not formed at this point in time.
facts.xnote: On "Box of Animals" (not a registered song slug — no song tag).

facts.speaker: wynton_huddle
facts.short: Medusa's first show was the main stage of the Chameleon Club in Lancaster… This was before we even had a bassist!

facts.speaker: wynton_huddle
facts.short: It was our second year in a row attending it and was even better than last year!
facts.xnote: On SXSW 2018 — their second year running (= played 2017 and 2018).

facts.speaker: wynton_huddle
facts.short: We don't suck. You won't hate us.

facts.speaker: wynton_huddle
facts.short: Hunter had an infatuation with cacti, but after pulling some needles out of his butt he's been less than eager.
facts.xnote: Austin, SXSW.

facts.speaker: wynton_huddle
facts.short: We do indeed. It's not an easy balancing act, but we will all do whatever we must to keep the ball rolling!
facts.xnote: On day jobs.

facts.speaker: wynton_huddle
facts.short: We went from engineer to engineer and bassist to bassist trying to find the right thing. The solution for both things was in the same person.

facts.speaker: wynton_huddle
facts.short: I was not expecting to find [our market] in the PA festival scene… we break the monotony up a little bit.

facts.speaker: justin_wohlfeil
facts.short: some of the songs have a new, rawer energy from that experience
facts.xnote: After the Who tribute set at Dam Stock.

facts.speaker: alex_aument
facts.short: I'm a really big fan of memes, so I'm glad to follow the page and see what people come up with; it gets me going.
facts.xnote: On the Medusa's Discult page.

facts.speaker: wynton_huddle
facts.short: The fans already know every single word to songs because we've been playing them for so long, and they're not even out yet

facts.speaker: wynton_huddle
facts.short: When people leave a show, we just want them to feel liberated and refreshed.

facts.speaker: lancaster_online
facts.short: Orphic Grimoire was recorded in Justin Wohlfeil's studio inside the Chameleon Club.
facts.long: The band hunkered down there from October 2018, in frequent four-hour sessions.

facts.speaker: lancaster_online
facts.short: August 2019 — Medusa's Disco opened for Godsmack at Allentown's Musikfest.
facts.xnote: Corroborated: PA Musician column, in-vault MV-HR-20260707-005.

facts.speaker: lancaster_online
facts.short: Fans ran a dedicated Facebook group: "Medusa's Discult."
facts.long: ~550 members in 2019 — per LNP, the only Lancaster band with its own fan group.

facts.speaker: lancaster_online
facts.short: A Who tribute set at "Dam Stock" in Austin, PA went so well it became a live recording.
facts.long: Plus a second Who-centric show at Tellus360, Nov 8, 2019.

facts.speaker: hunter_root
facts.short: I am Pennsylvania raised but I was born in Fayetteville, Arkansas. My brother and I both.

facts.speaker: hunter_root
facts.short: The main reason it's titled this is for my older brother, Nicholas Root… He would love this name and would completely get it, being born there means a lot to us both.

facts.speaker: hunter_root
facts.short: Nick passed away two years ago as of April 15th at the age of 27. I was 26 when he died. He played guitar before me and is the reason I picked it up to begin with.
facts.xnote: F-DEATH-DATE: dates Nick's death to 2021-04-15, age 27. HEAVY: passed as worded (Mike ruling 1).

facts.speaker: hunter_root
facts.short: One of his worries on his deathbed was that he wouldn't be remembered when he was gone. Fuck that, this one is forever for you Nick, I wouldn't be here without you!
facts.xnote: HEAVY+PROFANITY: passed as worded (Mike ruling 1).

facts.speaker: hill_douglas
facts.short: If you haven't heard of Hunter Root yet, I suggest you change that.

facts.speaker: hill_douglas
facts.short: This guy is the real deal, so you're going to want to mark your calendars for this one.

facts.speaker: whiskey_riff
facts.short: "Town Rat Heathen" dropped in January 2023 and went viral.
facts.long: Nearly a million Spotify streams inside four months.

facts.speaker: hunter_root
facts.short: I started playing drums and guitar at the age of twelve because of my older brother, Nick. He was a guitar player and was my first true inspiration to pick up an instrument.

facts.speaker: hunter_root
facts.short: My first influences were classic rock bands that my father listened to… The Rolling Stones, Led Zeppelin, The Doors, Lynyrd Skynyrd

facts.speaker: hunter_root
facts.short: Since I was a boy I just wanted to be able to make honest music for a living. That has always been my dream.

facts.speaker: hunter_root
facts.short: I don't think music in itself has goals. The true point of music is simply the music itself.

facts.speaker: hunter_root
facts.short: My favorite concert was probably the time I saw "Fuzz" at Underground Arts in Philly

facts.speaker: hunter_root
facts.short: "Arkansas" has strong folky, country, southern rock roots that permeate the whole record.

facts.speaker: hunter_root
facts.short: I released a twenty second clip on Tiktok of me singing and playing the first verse. It got 500k views which prompted me to finish the song and release it immediately.

facts.speaker: hunter_root
facts.short: I went from 400 monthly listeners to 100k in a few months. It's over 3M plays on Spotify now.
facts.long: "It is completely surreal… I feel blessed." — MuzicNotez, January 2024

facts.speaker: hunter_root
facts.short: you have way more time and freedom to do things at your own leisure. Art is sensitive so not being rushed affects the product tremendously.
facts.long: — Hunter Root on recording solo, MuzicNotez, 2024

facts.speaker: hunter_root
facts.short: I just want to thank all my friends and fans pre-viral for helping me get to this point… You know who you are. And thank you to the new fans, Much love.

facts.speaker: hunter_root
facts.short: The songs weren't written to deliver a message. They're simply confessions set to music.
facts.xnote: ONE home, three breadcrumbs (Mike ruling 4): primary Shore Fire announce MV-20260617-007; corroborated Jambands MV-20260617-008 and Shore Fire release-day MV-20260617-010 (fuller form).

facts.speaker: shore_fire_media
facts.short: Crooked Home was produced by Anders Osborne and engineered by David Kalmusky.
facts.long: Cut at Addiction Studios, Nashville; released October 17, 2025 via Tolok.
facts.xnote: CONFLICT-PRODUCER noted: D'Ambrosio pieces say 'producer David Kalmuskey'; worded per the three-source majority (Shore Fire, Jambands, Isthmus).

facts.speaker: shore_fire_media
facts.short: Chad Cromwell — Neil Young's and Mark Knopfler's drummer — plays on Crooked Home.
facts.long: With Marc Rogers on bass and keys, and Lindsay Lou's backing vocals on two tracks.

facts.speaker: shore_fire_media
facts.short: The "'94" single art is a childhood photo of Hunter and Nick.

facts.speaker: hunter_root
facts.short: Back in 1994 / Glad I woke up but I didn't wake up too sure / Back in 1993 / The devil made his way inside a kid and then he never broke free…
facts.xnote: LYRIC: speaker = Hunter Root, song in scope tags (Mike ruling 3). HEAVY: passed as worded.

facts.speaker: isthmus
facts.short: If you had to make up a name for a rocking but acoustic artist who tells straightforward stories without pathos, "Hunter Root" would fit the bill exactly.

facts.speaker: isthmus
facts.short: While the songs are in part a tribute to Root's brother, who died in 2021, the album isn't a downer.

facts.speaker: isthmus
facts.short: "Friendly Fire" was the third single off Crooked Home.
facts.long: Born from a fallout with close friends.

facts.speaker: isthmus
facts.short: The Crooked Home tour opened October 10, 2025, at The Abbey Bar in Harrisburg.
facts.long: Then New York, Philadelphia, Boston, Nashville, Chicago and more.

facts.speaker: hunter_root
facts.short: Crooked Home is a personal reckoning that tells the story of my life, a life shaped by loss, addiction, and illness.
facts.xnote: HEAVY: passed as worded.

facts.speaker: hunter_root
facts.short: I think a lot of folks listen to my music because it helps them through tough times. If there is anything I hope this album has to offer, it's that — a little bit of light.

facts.speaker: shore_fire_media
facts.short: Crooked Home was the first record Hunter cut live with a full band.
facts.xnote: Corroborated by Root's own words, The Country Note MV-20260617-013 (C74/fact 080).

facts.speaker: shore_fire_media
facts.short: The album ran through vintage mics once used by Bob Dylan and Marianne Faithfull.
facts.long: And reverb plates from Johnny Cash sessions.

facts.speaker: shore_fire_media
facts.short: "String Up a Necklace" is about a necklace his girlfriend made him.
facts.long: To remind him of home while touring.

facts.speaker: shore_fire_media
facts.short: "My Brother's Bones" is a tribute to Nick.
facts.long: Born of Hunter's wish to give his brother a proper resting place.
facts.xnote: HEAVY: passed as worded.

facts.speaker: shore_fire_media
facts.short: "Flash in the Pan" is about working-class hardship.
facts.long: The divide between wealth and the lower-middle-class world Hunter grew up in.

facts.speaker: hunter_root
facts.short: Half the songs ended up being about my brother… '94' was almost the album title. It's the heart of it all.

facts.speaker: hunter_root
facts.short: He was a heroin addict since he was about fifteen. He got sarcoma while he was living in Kensington, Philly… and he came home to die. I was there for the last six months of his life.
facts.xnote: HEAVY: passed as worded.

facts.speaker: hunter_root
facts.short: He was doing hospice in our living room. It woke me up. When he died—only eleven months older than me—it felt like a piece of me went with him.
facts.xnote: HEAVY: passed as worded.

facts.speaker: hunter_root
facts.short: I'd just run to my room, grab the guitar, and hide in music. That was my formula for dealing with stuff. It's a healthy habit I built early, and it's what's kept me alive.

facts.speaker: hunter_root
facts.short: My brother's biggest fear was not being remembered. So it was obvious what I had to do: remember him through music. I didn't plan it out, but it became everything.

facts.speaker: hunter_root
facts.short: That Bronco was huge for us. When my dad sold it after we moved back to Pennsylvania, my brother cried. It's in the ''94' video.

facts.speaker: hunter_root
facts.short: Two weeks before he died, he wanted to go back to Kensington one last time to get high… Watching him wheel himself away, looking like a skeleton—it's burned in my brain.
facts.xnote: HEAVY: passed as worded. Full run includes the '94 lyric "Deathbed, wheelchair, off he goes…" (LYRIC ruling: speaker stays Hunter Root).

facts.speaker: hunter_root
facts.short: It made people cry. That's when I knew—it's my first truly sad song, intentionally sad… That's what they want from music, and that's what I want to give: honesty.

facts.speaker: hunter_root
facts.short: He started playing guitar first, when he was eight. He's the reason I play. I wanted to be in a band with him. I wouldn't be doing any of this if it wasn't for him.

facts.speaker: hunter_root
facts.short: The label put money into the record, but it's still just me being me. The quality's higher, but the goal's the same: to turn pain into something that matters.

facts.speaker: hunter_root
facts.short: My brother was always running from something dark. I'm just trying to face it head-on through music. That's how I keep him alive. That's how I keep myself alive.

facts.speaker: americana_highways
facts.short: Crooked Home was Hunter's first label-backed release.
facts.long: At 30, based in Columbia, outside Lancaster.

facts.speaker: hunter_root
facts.short: For the first time ever, all I had to do was sing and play in real time. It was the best result I have ever had. More honest. More alive.

facts.speaker: hunter_root
facts.short: I have been playing music since I was twelve. I am just a full blooded musician. That is all I know how to do.

facts.speaker: the_country_note
facts.short: It's spelled Root — but pronounced "Rut."
facts.long: The spelling stuck as the stage name; he says it suits the music's earthy tone.

facts.speaker: hunter_root
facts.short: I have always struggled to fit in genre wise. Every time I hear something new, it ends up in my music. I do not want to land anywhere because I like so many styles.

facts.speaker: hunter_root
facts.short: Arkansas was the first time I wrote real lines about real places and the things I actually did. And that is when people connected.

facts.speaker: hunter_root
facts.short: People were not just connecting with vague lines. They connected with the exact story. My dad in jail. My brother in rehab. The legal drug stuff.
facts.xnote: HEAVY: passed as worded.

facts.speaker: hunter_root
facts.short: If I was on a deserted island, I would just need my guitar and the ability to play a song all the way through. That is home for me.

facts.speaker: hunter_root
facts.short: This is my heart and soul. Not being able to tour weighs on me mentally. But I still have room to get better. I am not worried.
facts.xnote: On Lyme disease and cancelled tours.

facts.speaker: hunter_root
facts.short: Everything I love about Hank, that is what people connect with in my music. That is wild to think about.
facts.xnote: Hank Williams; his 'title track of my life right now' = "Men With Broken Hearts".

facts.speaker: michelle_osterhoudt
facts.short: Struggle is struggle.
facts.xnote: The interviewer's line that unlocked him — framing per candidates doc, passed at gate.

facts.speaker: the_country_note
facts.short: A song he wishes he could hear again for the first time.
facts.long: Nirvana's unplugged "Where Did You Sleep Last Night."

facts.speaker: the_country_note
facts.short: The lyric comes first now — it used to be the riff.
facts.long: Notebook and pen; writing happens on the couch with the TV off, or on a long walk with coffee.

facts.speaker: the_country_note
facts.short: He grew up in Lancaster's Amish country.
facts.long: Rural life plus psychedelic rock, grunge, and bluegrass shaped the sound.

facts.speaker: michele_kelly
facts.short: The night after opening for Godsmack, Medusa's Disco closed the Peace of Mind series at Rt. 61 Roadhouse in Sunbury.
facts.long: "They showed no signs of disinterest" — PA Musician's columnist.

facts.speaker: pa_musician
facts.short: "Book Upon My Shelf" landed August 14, 2019.
facts.long: The band's first single in three years.

facts.speaker: sarah_kate_gittleman
facts.short: Medusa's Disco's songwriting is a quality that sets them apart from other bands.

facts.speaker: sarah_kate_gittleman
facts.short: the album is a perfect snapshot of the energy that Medusa's Disco brings to listeners

facts.speaker: nepaudio
facts.short: Orphic Grimoire — the band's fourth studio release.
facts.long: Recorded, mixed, and produced entirely by Medusa's Disco.

facts.speaker: nepaudio
facts.short: "Belly Ache" carries a saxophone break by YAM YAM's Jason Mescia.
facts.xnote: belly_ache not a registered song slug — no song tag, per candidates doc.

facts.speaker: sarah_kate_gittleman
facts.short: On "Sizzle Into Oblivion": "it is nothing short of the stuff goosebumps are risen from."
facts.long: The album closer — per the review, the most popular song among fans.
facts.xnote: sizzle_into_oblivion not a registered song slug — no song tag, per candidates doc.
